rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with an expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but the response overstates confidence about ICM location/quality and TE cohesiveness from this single somewhat indistinct image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, PCOS, ovarian reserve, semen parameters, endometrium, and prior failed cycles with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around good embryo quality tempered by prior failures; only minor overinterpretation of hidden implantation factors from limited history.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including caution about routine PGT-A at age 32 and uterine review after repeated failures; minor speculative comments on PCOS/endometrial synchrony are less guideline-grounded.
Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future evaluation, including cavity assessment, luteal review, metabolic optimization, and selective further testing.
